brief_raw: Build a landing page for Cadence, a developer tool. Dark.

surface.rendering: static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, offline file:// only, no CDN, no remote fonts/images, no network calls

product.name: Cadence
product.concept: Cadence schedules and paces software releases: it lines up feature-flag rollouts, deploy windows, and rollback safety nets into a predictable rhythm ('release trains') instead of ad-hoc pushes.
product.why_this_reading: The brief supplies only a name and category. 'Cadence' denotes a repeating rhythmic pattern, which grounds a defensible, non-generic product concept (tempo/pulse of releases) rather than a vague 'developer tool' placeholder.

audience.primary: engineering leads and platform/DevOps engineers at product teams shipping multiple services
audience.mindset_on_arrival: skeptical of another dashboard; wants to see the mechanism (how releases get paced) before caring about the pitch
audience.technical_fluency: high — comfortable with CLI, YAML config, git terminology; copy can assume this

outcome.business_goal: drive trial signups / demo requests for a dev-tool product
outcome.secondary_action: Read the docs / view a sample release-train config

action.conversion_shape: single above-the-fold CTA pair, restated once at page end; no pricing page in scope (out of scope per brief brevity)

taste_targets.layout: high — editorial, asymmetric hero and timeline section; at least two distinct layout models across the 3+ content sections
taste_targets.typography: mid-high — one modular scale (ratio 1.333), system font stacks only (no remote fonts allowed), mono for code/labels, humanist sans for body
taste_targets.spacing: mid, trending airy on marketing bands — base unit 8px
taste_targets.motion: mid — restrained but purposeful; a slow ambient pulse device in the hero, short state transitions elsewhere, full prefers-reduced-motion fallback
taste_targets.iconography: mid — one hand-authored line-icon family, 24px grid, 1.75px stroke, used sparingly
taste_targets.depth: low-mid — mostly flat dark surfaces with a small elevation ramp (page / card / raised), tinted soft shadows, no glass
taste_targets.consistency: not scorable — first generation, no established project design system to inherit from

out_of_scope: auth flows (sign in / sign up forms beyond the CTA)
blog, changelog, or docs content beyond a single illustrative snippet
real third-party logos or named customers (would require unverifiable brand/identity claims)
